tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue (staticPrimaryColor). Primary buttons, links (TLink), active nav item, focus, selected tabs, checkbox/radio/select accents — VBtn/VTabs/VCheckbox default color.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill. Contrast on `primary`: 3.68:1 light, 3.68:1 dark — passes only for large/bold text (3:1); kept exact from source.

tokens.name: primary-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover state of `primary` links (TLink hover).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Neutral secondary actions and secondary chips/badges.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a `secondary` fill. Contrast on `secondary`: 3.77:1 light, 3.77:1 dark — passes only for large/bold text (3:1); kept exact from source.

tokens.name: secondary-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed `secondary`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: completed payments, active accounts, success alerts.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a `success` fill. Contrast on `success`: 2.28:1 light, 2.21:1 dark — FAILS WCAG even for large text; kept exact from source. Where white text must sit on this hue, use the 700 step of the same scale as the fill.

tokens.name: success-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed `success`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational alerts, chips and charts.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text on an `info` fill. Contrast on `info`: 2.43:1 light, 2.35:1 dark — FAILS WCAG even for large text; kept exact from source. Where white text must sit on this hue, use the 700 step of the same scale as the fill.

tokens.name: info-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed `info`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / attention states (unpaid, awaiting).

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a `warning` fill. Contrast on `warning`: 1.92:1 light, 2.04:1 dark — FAILS WCAG even for large text; kept exact from source. Where white text must sit on this hue, use the 700 step of the same scale as the fill.

tokens.name: warning-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed `warning`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, failed / disabled states, field validation.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an `error` fill. Contrast on `error`: 3.76:1 light, 3.28:1 dark — passes only for large/bold text (3:1); kept exact from source.

tokens.name: error-darken-1
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed `error`.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind cards and the layout.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Headings and high-emphasis text on `background`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus, nav drawer, tables.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Body text on `surface` (used at high/medium emphasis opacities). 7.73:1 light, 9.45:1 dark.
